updates.note: Management stated capacity will expand to 180 to 190 million units annually by next fiscal.
updates.quote: will further expand its capacity to 180 to 190 million units annually by next fiscal.

updates.note: Management stated IT hardware business is expected to be almost INR 15,000 crore to INR 20,000 crore in the next couple of years.
updates.quote: We feel that in next couple of years, this is going to be almost INR 15,000 crore to INR 20,000 crore business for us.

updates.note: Front-loading washing machines launch is delayed to Q3 FY27.
updates.quote: launch of fully automatic front-loading washing machines in Q3 of the current fiscal in Tirupati.

updates.note: Management targeted INR 2,500 crores to INR 3,000 crores for Q Tech next year.
updates.quote: broadly we should be in a kind of a number of almost somewhere between INR 2,500 crores to INR 3,000 odd crores.

updates.note: Management stated display business can generate revenues closer to INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores once completely ramped up.
updates.quote: it can generate revenues of closer to INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores.

new_promises.statement: IT hardware revenue is expected to reach around INR 6,000 crores in the current fiscal.
new_promises.quote: this year itself we feel confident that we are going to be somewhere around INR 6,000 crores in this business.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Vivo JV volume is expected to be around 20 to 21 million next year.
new_promises.quote: We feel that in the JV we should be doing around 20-21 million.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Q Tech revenue target for next year is between INR 2,500 crores and INR 3,000 crores.
new_promises.quote: broadly we should be in a kind of a number of almost somewhere between INR 2,500 crores to INR 3,000 odd crores.
new_promises.speaker: Saurabh Gupta

new_promises.statement: IT hardware business Capex commitment increased to INR 500 crores under IT PLI 2.
new_promises.quote: we are upping our CAPEX plans to INR 500 crores.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall
